clinical_methods.source_scope: Only named METHODS patient-collection/clinical-covariate paragraphs. Cohort selection definitions exposed, no individual endpoint rows or molecular values.
clinical_methods.collection: Siriraj/Columbia archival tissue 2008–2018. 22 initially identified, post-QC/outlier and unrelated-death/missing-prognosis exclusions result in 12 final prognostic cases; no inference that 12 equals full natural-history cohort.
clinical_methods.origin_definition: OS from diagnosis to date of last follow-up as source wording; no individual first local/distant event origins or assessment histories authenticated here.
clinical_methods.outcome_selection: Good/poor prognostic groups are survival-outcome selected; source threshold 8 years. Not an unselected localized competing-event cohort.
clinical_methods.methods_do_not_establish: Individual entry, local/distant first-event, competing-death/censor and treatment histories or full eligible-cohort event matrix.
